name: studio-retro-constraints
description: Hardware-style constraint profiles for the pixel-art validation commands (tools-assets.py). Each profile is checked against sprites/tilesheets: palette size, sprite cell size, colors per sprite region, and tile grid requirements.

nes-basic.notes: 3 colors + transparency per sprite/tile from the system palette

snes-casual.notes: approximate casual limits; real per-scanline limits not modeled

shared_rules: no semi-transparent pixels in indexed sprite output
palette indices stay stable across animation frames (palette swap compatible)
sprites align to the tile grid unless flagged off-grid intentionally
scaling of pixel art for preview uses nearest-neighbor only
